== cats, dogs and diagrams ==

== some rules for a bit of English ==
Here is an extremely small and silly [[cats|ruleset]] for a small number of English sentences:   

   - out                     <- eof - ;
   - sentence                <- eof - ;
   - subject verb object '.' <- sentence ;
   
   - nounphrase              <- subject ;
   - nounphrase              <- object  ;
   
   'the ' noun               <- nounphrase ;
   'a '   noun               <- nounphrase ;
   
   'cat '                    <- noun;
   'dog '                    <- noun;
   'bit '                    <- noun;

   'bit '                    <- verb;
   'ate '                    <- verb;
   'likes '                  <- verb;
   
   ' '                       <- - ;
   '\n'                      <- - ;

== lm-diagram from these rules ==
First compile the rules as a shell sciript.

  [peri@p2 v]$ make cats.lm
  lm2n2m -o cats.lm -s /usr/bin/lm cats.lmn

Try the script to see the diagram:

  chmod u+x cats.lm
  [peri@p2 v]$ ./cats.lm -W 40 -t D
  the cat likes the dog .
